register_ssl_configs: register wav2vec2 SSL config architectures xlsr_base 1b 3b and 7b into a DependencyContainer
build_xlsr_base_config: build an xlsr_base wav2vec2 config by extending large_lv60k with zero attention dropout
build_1b_ssl_config: build a 1b parameter wav2vec2 SSL config with 48 encoder layers and 1280 model dimension
build_3b_ssl_config: build a 3b parameter wav2vec2 SSL config with 60 encoder layers and 2048 model dimension
build_7b_ssl_config: build a 7b parameter wav2vec2 SSL config with 128 encoder layers and 16 attention heads
